scope: External pinned 500-task corpus validation and complete externally executed evidence ingestion; not task execution or installed authorization
implementation: Exactly 500 unique sorted task IDs with retained nonduplicate input/oracle identities, independently supplied corpus, current run/tuple manifest, observations and adjudication hashes

Single-link bounded regular evidence, canonical relative paths checked before metadata access, alias/reparse refusal, full retained byte hashes and final re-observation; no arbitrary command execution, downloads or native authority changes

Literal-byte, strict typed JSON with exact bounded decimal numbers, fixed-decimal CSV and explicit refusal oracles; qualitative cases require a separately pinned external human rubric decision joined to the actual retained artifact set
Malformed expected oracles or evidence joins refuse the protocol; malformed actual JSON/CSV task results count as oracle failures rather than aborting or silently dropping a task
Shared oracle data is validated without retaining hundreds of duplicate large buffers. Only the current task's oracle/artifacts are loaded for comparison, with bounded unique evidence accounting
Every attempt, failure, cancellation, false refusal, retry and repair remains in the report. Initial and final quality tallies are separate; repair eligibility is not invented
Nearest-rank P95 timing and peak-memory measurements and energy totals retain their run/context joins and measurement method/domain. A self-reported model success is never a deterministic oracle
